_description: Bigger is worse: a T-shaped room rewards compact enclosures rather than tracing every boundary. With A=1, C=-3.5 and G=0, a central 10x15 rectangle scores 975, the full T scores 935, the 30x5 lower wing scores 905, and a 5x5 square scores 955. Inventory supports all four examples. Only right and straight connectors are available; there is one gate, so no second-gate bonus. These are validated candidate scores, not a claim of a proven global optimum.
